findings.F1: Sense 1 example 'I felt sick during three hours.' uses during with a bare length of time, which needs for, and it contradicts the entry's own learner error.
findings.F2: The usage note falsely says during can be followed by a clause with its own subject (*during we were eating*).
findings.F3: The during/while contrast (noun versus clause) is stated in both usage_note and learner_errors, against the one-fact-one-field rule.
findings.F4: The sense 1 signpost 'all through a period' has four words, over the three-word limit.
findings.F5: The sense 2 signpost 'at some point within' has four words, over the three-word limit.
